name: Kent County, RI
findings: Kent County has 613 nonprofit organizations. 224 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 189 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Kent County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few religious organizations list public events
observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 25 would.

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 39 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 39 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
